question: Which 3 affiliations had the most papers in 2009?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_author_affiliation" AS SELECT CAST(affiliation_id AS TEXT) AS affiliation_id, paper_author_combined FROM table_2
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "papers" AS SELECT title, paper_info FROM table_3

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH papers_parsed AS (
    SELECT
        split_part(paper_info, '|', 1) AS paper_id,
        split_part(paper_info, '|', 2) AS venue,
        CAST(split_part(paper_info, '|', 3) AS INTEGER) AS year
    FROM papers
), paa_parsed AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(affiliation_id AS TEXT) AS affiliation_id,
        split_part(paper_author_combined, '||', 1) AS paper_id,
        split_part(paper_author_combined, '||', 2) AS author_id
    FROM paper_author_affiliation
), paper_affil_2009 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.paper_id,
        pa.affiliation_id
    FROM papers_parsed p
    JOIN paa_parsed pa
      ON p.paper_id = pa.paper_id
    WHERE p.year = 2009
), counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.affiliation_id,
        COUNT(*) AS paper_count
    FROM paper_affil_2009 a
    GROUP BY a.affiliation_id
), labeled AS (
    SELECT
        c.affiliation_id,
        COALESCE(aff.name, c.affiliation_id) AS affiliation_name,
        c.paper_count
    FROM counts c
    LEFT JOIN affiliations aff
      ON aff.affiliation_id = c.affiliation_id
)
SELECT affiliation_name, paper_count
FROM labeled
ORDER BY paper_count DESC, affiliation_name ASC
LIMIT 3;
